Card Q&A.a: Yes, it activates."You may place 1 green or blue Digimon card with [Dramon] in its name from your hand under this Digimon as its bottom digivolution card" activates when digivolving normally or when DNA digivolving. The "When DNA digivolving, you may play 1 green or blue Digimon card with [Dramon] in its name and 12000 DP or less from your hand without paying the cost" part activates only when DNA digivolving.
